description: Election Commission - Mr. U. U. P. Perera of the Millaniya Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his office of member of that P/S
categorisation: This gazette notice declares a vacancy in a local government authority (Millaniya Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a member ceasing to belong to their political party. This falls under electoral processes and matters related to local authority elections, specifically under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, making it an Elections Gazette (Type 7).
